allow.why: Timed benchmark steps run one after another by design, a parallel run would measure the contention
MediaQueryList implements the DOM removeEventListener and counts its listeners through it
the method name is fixed by the Renderer contract of svelte/renderer, this is a definition, not a call
the fixtures feed the unit conversion under test, so px is the input
`<button>` here is the React Native Button tag, not an HTML form button, and takes no `type`
IStyleClaims is the point a package merges its own style object into; a type alias cannot merge
the busy-wait freezes the JS thread on purpose, so the clock is read on every pass
